advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add adversarial validation tests asserting `_check_execution` emits `unknown_adapter`, `unknown_init`, `handler_without_adapter`, and `prefix_without_argv` on synthetic malformed routes (mirroring the existing `_codes([...])` rejection tests).
evidence: search_files for `handler_without_adapter`, `unknown_adapter`, `prefix_without_argv`, `unknown_init` returns matches ONLY in src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py — no test asserts any of these codes

tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py carries adversarial 'rejected' tests for every OTHER check: `test_duplicate_spelling_rejected` (145), `test_unknown_capability_rejected` (177), `test_malformed_handler_reference_rejected` (188), `test_retired_route_with_handler_is_contradiction` (229) — but none for the four `_check_execution` codes

The only `_check_execution`-adjacent coverage is `test_shipped_route_table_validates_clean` (tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:122), which is the clean/negative path only — it cannot detect a regression that stops a check from firing
advisory.finding: The new registry validation function `_check_execution` emits four detection codes (`unknown_adapter`, `unknown_init`, `handler_without_adapter`, `prefix_without_argv`) whose fault-detecting path is untested. Every sibling validation check has a paired adversarial 'rejected' test in tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py, but these four have none — only the clean-table positive path is exercised. A regression that weakened any of these guards would pass all tests.
scenarios: A future route sets a handler but leaves adapter empty and the `handler_without_adapter` guard is silently broken — no test fails
An `argv_prefix` is attached to a non-argv adapter (dispatch would drop it) and the `prefix_without_argv` guard regresses — no test fails
advisory.suggested_fix: In tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py add, e.g.: `assert "unknown_adapter" in _codes([_route("x", handler="m:f", adapter="bogus")])`; `assert "unknown_init" in _codes([_route("x", init="bogus")])`; `assert "handler_without_adapter" in _codes([_route("x", handler="m:f")])`; `assert "prefix_without_argv" in _codes([_route("x", handler="m:f", adapter="dispatcher", argv_prefix=("status",))])`.
